column1: # The model and effort of every phase of a package, by the package's class and by the tool that
# runs it: one definition per project, read by the person in charge each time it starts a phase
# session. A coordinator reads only the rows of its own tool.
# Columns: tool <TAB> phase <TAB> class <TAB> model <TAB> effort
# tool    claude, codex or agy, by the name of its command on PATH. Each tool is its own ecosystem
#         with its own coordinator and its own models: no session of one calls another's tool, and
#         a package runs in one of them from its plan to its release and never moves to another.
#         ECOSYSTEM_ORDER in config.env says which ecosystem takes up a new package. A tool with
#         no rows runs no phase, and a class without rows of a tool is not that tool's work.
# phase   plan, plan-check, build (build and test), review, ui-test (the UI test and the live
#         check), helper (a bounded task inside any phase: a pre-review of a diff, a log, a
#         screenshot, a long span; its answer is checked by the session that asked). The start
#         check is a script of the project and has no row; the plan check runs `ai-core
#         contract-scan` before its model reads the plan, so its row names only the model.
# class   mechanical (a rename or a text, no contract touched), high-risk (security, payments,
#         contracts outward, the push gate), normal-hard (everything else); * for every class.
# model   what the tool's --model takes (`claude --model`, `codex -m`, `agy --model`, as `agy models`
#         lists it); script where the script alone decides.
# effort  what the tool takes for it (`claude --effort`, `codex -c model_reasoning_effort=`); - where
#         the model name carries it, as agy's names do.
# A phase never moves to another model, effort or tool because a quota ran out: it waits. The
# reviewer of a package never runs on the model that built it. A project harness replaces the
# whole file with its own: the same name replaces.
